tasks.label: Run EscortVIPs - Dashboard
tasks.command: if (-not $env:ARCGIS_API_KEY) { $env:ARCGIS_API_KEY = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ARCGIS_API_KEY','User') }; if (-not $env:ARCGIS_API_KEY) { throw 'ARCGIS_API_KEY is not set. Set it in your user environment.' }; dotnet run --project ./EscortVIPs/CommandDashboard/CommandDashboard.csproj --no-build

tasks.label: Run EscortVIPs - Field App Escort
tasks.command: dotnet run --project ./EscortVIPs/FieldMobileApp/FieldMobileApp.csproj -f net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 --no-build -- --role Escort --mode simulated --device Escort --session DEVSUMMIT-2026 --host ws://127.0.0.1:8765/ws/ --sim-host ws://127.0.0.1:8775/ws/ --autoconnect --exit-on-disconnect

windows.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; taskkill /IM SimulationEngine.exe /F | Out-Null; taskkill /IM CommandDashboard.exe /F | Out-Null; taskkill /IM FieldMobileApp.exe /F | Out-Null; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name = 'dotnet.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*EscortVIPs*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0
